modelLimits.type: Authored qualitative visual interpretation; not a calibrated CFD or molecular simulation.
modelLimits.selectedSystem: Conventional slit nib, feed, aqueous dye ink and ivory writing paper.
limits: Magnification, geometry, timing and bubble frequency are compositional choices, not measured pressures, dimensions or flow rates.
Counterflow communicates exchange; replacement air is admitted intermittently.
Fin grooves buffer excess ink; the main route remains longitudinal.
Held liquid is a magnified attached meniscus, not normal continuous dripping.
Paper draws liquid at contact; uptake and evaporation overlap.
A matte trace is the chosen ink/paper finish, not a universal property.
